caption: The drawing depicts a section of ornate wrought ironwork, rendered in black on a beige background. The upper horizontal bar is adorned with three identical finials consisting of symmetrical, foliated scroll designs. On the left side, there is a vertically-oriented lyre-shaped element with decorative curves and floral motifs at its base. From the top bar, two curved chains hang, meeting at the center where a pendant ornament and a tassel-like object dangle. The right side features swirling acanthus-like vine scrollwork that fills the vertical panel. Along the bottom horizontal bar, there is a series of intersecting diagonal rails, each decorated with grape clusters and vine leaves, forming a continuous decorative band. The objects are drawn in a single, consistent monochrome style with detailed shading to suggest texture and depth. The name "CHARLOTTE ANGUS" is printed in small capital letters in the lower right corner.
title: Cemetary Plot Enclosure
